dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would your liquor be better than Dawn Winery's?

dialogues.speaker: Karpillia
dialogues.text: Ah, never mind. As a drinker myself, I can't go against my conscience in this matter.

dialogues.speaker: Karpillia
dialogues.text: I have to admit that Dawn Winery's drinks are better. Even I prefer them.

dialogues.speaker: Karpillia
dialogues.text: Our store was actually forced to sell liquor here because we couldn't compete against Angel's Share.

dialogues.speaker: Karpillia
dialogues.text: But the businesses under Dawn Winery have practically monopolized the liquor industry in Mondstadt. I... don't really think that's a good thing.
